slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: updated_text
slots.about: the quiet line under the title

slots.name: groups
slots.about: the named groups in order: id (1 or more), name; group 0 is the pinned block on top, it has no header and does not fold

slots.name: rows
slots.about: the rows: id, group (where it is now, 0 when pinned), home (its named group), name, icon (a Tabler icon name), count, off (true dims it and it does nothing)

slots.name: edit_word
slots.about: the top button while not editing

slots.name: pin_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's name on its pin button

slots.name: unpin_word
slots.about: spoken before a row's name on its unpin button

slots.name: fold_word
slots.about: spoken before a group's name on its header while open

slots.name: unfold_word
slots.about: spoken before a group's name on its header while folded

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: what shows when there is no row

empty.shows: empty; an empty pinned block is left out, a named group keeps its header

fallback.shows: an off row is dimmed and its tap does nothing

attention.shows: a count only where there is something to count

labels.header: fold_word or unfold_word and the group
labels.open: the name and the count when above 0
labels.pin: pin_word or unpin_word and the name

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink and swap

notes: Group 0 is the pinned block: no header, never folds, left out while empty. Pinning moves a row to group 0 and unpinning sends it back to its home group.
